notes.title: Kickback Clicker has undergone many changes since the demo version was released!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634270/51be281917bdfca6532ce089729817f7785f0024.gif"][/img][/p][p]While Kickback Clicker is still under development, we'd like to share some progress, like a completely new upgrade menu! It will feature a tree-like system which you can easily navigate between missions without any rush.[/p]
